# Lehigh Valley

[All metro areas](../data-sources.md)

**Covers:** Lehigh and Northampton Counties (Allentown, Bethlehem and Easton), Carbon County, Monroe County in the Poconos, and Warren County, NJ. The title bar shows which of these parts a place is in: Lehigh County, PA, Northampton County, PA, Carbon County, PA, Monroe County, PA or Warren County, NJ.

**Counties:** Lehigh County, PA; Northampton County, PA; Carbon County, PA; Monroe County, PA; Warren County, NJ. Within the service area, the app tells which metro area and which of its parts a place is in by its county, or, on the water or a pier, by the nearest county. [Why these counties](../metro-areas.md#lehigh-valley)

## Operators

| Operator | Runs | Real-time | Key needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| LANta (Lehigh and Northampton Transportation Authority) | Buses in Lehigh, Northampton and Carbon Counties | Yes | No |
| Monroe County Transit Authority (Pocono Pony) | Buses in Monroe County | Yes | No |
| Warren County (Warren County Transportation, through NJ Transit's website) | Shuttles from Phillipsburg and from Hackettstown to Washington | No | No |
| Trans-Bridge Lines (through NJ Transit's website) | Coaches from Allentown, Bethlehem and Easton to New York and Newark Airport | No | No |
| NJ Transit | Trains from Hackettstown and buses in Phillipsburg and to Easton | With your own account | Optional NJ Transit developer account ([sign up](https://developer.njtransit.com/registration)) |

## Keys and accounts

Most real-time feeds here are free and need no key. For the ones below, you request a key or account yourself. Each is free, each person uses their own, and the app keeps it only in the macOS Keychain. Without it, that operator's times come from its timetable and are marked "Timetable", except where noted below.

- **NJ Transit developer account** (NJ Transit rail and bus real-time data): sign up on the [NJ Transit developer site](https://developer.njtransit.com/registration) and select the GTFS-RAIL and GTFS-BUS APIs. NJ Transit reviews each request and emails you when the account is approved. Enter the same username and password in **Settings → Data source → Keys and accounts**, with the username written exactly as the developer site shows it at the top right and the approval email writes it, including capital letters.
